fusions.name: Every Strand Strikes
fusions.desc: Looses 5 serpent strands at once, spread apart; each deals 8 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, and every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Tangling Tress
fusions.desc: A lashing strand that strikes an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 9 poison damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Gorgon's Glare
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Writhing Braid
fusions.desc: A bonded gorgonet fights beside you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.
